events.title: Mild fever & dry cough onset
events.description: Patient woke up feeling fatigued with throat irritation and mild shivering.

events.title: Paracetamol 650mg taken
events.description: First dose taken after light breakfast. Mild relief in headache noted.

events.title: Temperature spike 100.8°F, Pulse 88 bpm
events.description: Evening temperature elevation logged via Omron digital thermometer.

events.title: Azithromycin 500mg missed (vomiting)
events.description: Patient felt nauseous upon taking tablet and vomited 15 mins later. Dose skipped.

events.title: Persistent dry cough turning productive
events.description: Sputum noted yellowish. Patient reporting retrosternal chest soreness on coughing.

events.title: Temperature 101.8°F, SpO2 96%
events.description: Night sweats and shivering. Cold sponging applied by spouse.

events.title: Paracetamol 650mg + ORS Sachet taken
events.description: Electrolyte hydration started. Morning fever suppressed temporarily to 100.2°F.

events.title: High Spike: Temp 102.6°F, HR 104 bpm, SpO2 94%
events.description: Patient flushed, confused when questioned about date. Tachycardia noted.

events.title: CBC & Inflammatory Markers Lab Report
events.description: Leukocytosis (WBC 14,800/mcL, Neutrophils 82%), CRP elevated at 34 mg/L.

events.title: Postural dizziness & acute breathlessness on standing
events.description: Patient felt faint trying to walk to bathroom. Supported by family.

events.title: Critical Drop: SpO2 92%, BP 142/92, Pulse 112 bpm
events.description: Marked respiratory distress, tachypneic at 26 breaths/min. Emergency transfer initiated.

events.title: Emergency EMS Transfer to Apex Memorial ER
events.description: Spouse dialed EMS. Paramedic oxygen supplement 4L/min via nasal cannula started in transit.

events.title: EMS Handover Completed at Apex Memorial ER
events.description: Structured MIST handover received by Emergency Attending. Care transferred.
